Plotly.js Cartesian 4.1.1 and its Simplified Chinese locale are bundled locally for offline chart interaction. This bundle includes scatter/line, bar, box and pie traces.

- Bundle: https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-cartesian-4.1.1.min.js
- Downloaded source: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v4.1.1/dist/plotly-cartesian.min.js
- Locale: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v4.1.1/dist/plotly-locale-zh-cn.js
- License: MIT, retained in `plotly-LICENSE` and the bundle header.
- Interaction API: https://plotly.com/javascript/configuration-options/

No runtime CDN requests are made.
